verses.text: Praise Yahweh, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!
lines: Praise Yahweh, my soul!
All that is within me, praise his holy name!

verses.text: Praise Yahweh, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits,
lines: Praise Yahweh, my soul,
and don’t forget all his benefits,

verses.text: who forgives all your sins, who heals all your diseases,
lines: who forgives all your sins,
who heals all your diseases,

verses.text: who redeems your life from destruction, who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies,
lines: who redeems your life from destruction,
who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies,

verses.text: who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
lines: who satisfies your desire with good things,
so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

verses.text: Yahweh executes righteous acts, and justice for all who are oppressed.
lines: Yahweh executes righteous acts,
and justice for all who are oppressed.

verses.text: He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the children of Israel.
lines: He made known his ways to Moses,
his deeds to the children of Israel.

verses.text: Yahweh is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.
lines: Yahweh is merciful and gracious,
slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.

verses.text: He will not always accuse; neither will he stay angry forever.
lines: He will not always accuse;
neither will he stay angry forever.

verses.text: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us for our iniquities.
lines: He has not dealt with us according to our sins,
nor repaid us for our iniquities.

verses.text: For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.
lines: For as the heavens are high above the earth,
so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.

verses.text: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
lines: As far as the east is from the west,
so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

verses.text: Like a father has compassion on his children, so Yahweh has compassion on those who fear him.
lines: Like a father has compassion on his children,
so Yahweh has compassion on those who fear him.

verses.text: For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.
lines: For he knows how we are made.
He remembers that we are dust.

verses.text: As for man, his days are like grass. As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.
lines: As for man, his days are like grass.
As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.

verses.text: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more.
lines: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone.
Its place remembers it no more.

verses.text: But Yahweh’s loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him, his righteousness to children’s children,
lines: But Yahweh’s loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him,
his righteousness to children’s children,

verses.text: to those who keep his covenant, to those who remember to obey his precepts.
lines: to those who keep his covenant,
to those who remember to obey his precepts.

verses.text: Yahweh has established his throne in the heavens. His kingdom rules over all.
lines: Yahweh has established his throne in the heavens.
His kingdom rules over all.

verses.text: Praise Yahweh, you angels of his, who are mighty in strength, who fulfill his word, obeying the voice of his word.
lines: Praise Yahweh, you angels of his,
who are mighty in strength, who fulfill his word,
obeying the voice of his word.

verses.text: Praise Yahweh, all you armies of his, you servants of his, who do his pleasure.
lines: Praise Yahweh, all you armies of his,
you servants of his, who do his pleasure.

verses.text: Praise Yahweh, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion. Praise Yahweh, my soul!
lines: Praise Yahweh, all you works of his,
in all places of his dominion.
Praise Yahweh, my soul!
